title: DE LA DÉCHARGE À LA FORTUNE 💰

scenes.image: A poor tired man with a giant mango head, ragged plaid shirt, carrying a wicker basket of plastic bottles, and a poor woman with a giant cherry head in a torn dress, searching a huge garbage dump, dusty sunlight.

lines.say: La Mangue et la Cerise vivaient de ce qu'elles trouvaient à la décharge.

scenes.image: The mango-head man kneels in the garbage and holds up a crumpled lottery ticket, amazed; the cherry-head woman leans over his shoulder, surprised.

lines.say: Cerise… regarde ce que j'ai trouvé dans les poubelles !

scenes.image: The mango-head man and the cherry-head woman, now in elegant clothes, scream with joy in front of a TV showing the winning lottery numbers and a huge jackpot, money flying, luxury villa living room.

lines.say: C'était le ticket gagnant. Le gros lot !

scenes.image: The rich mango-head man in a luxury suit and the cherry-head woman in a gown stand at the gate of their mansion, while snobbish fruit-head neighbors (lemon, grape) who used to mock them come begging with fake smiles.

lines.say: Tiens, vous vous souvenez de nous maintenant ?

caption:
💰 Ils vivaient dans une décharge… jusqu'à ce ticket 🎟️

Et toi, tu aiderais ceux qui se moquaient de toi ? 👇
Partie 2 ?
